SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS row_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sale_id) AS distinct_keys,
  TO_HEX(
    SHA256(
      STRING_AGG(
        
          CONCAT(
            IFNULL(CAST(sale_id AS STRING), ''),
            '\t',
            IFNULL(CAST(sale_date AS STRING), ''),
            '\t',
            IFNULL(CAST(branch_id AS STRING), ''),
            '\t',
            IFNULL(CAST(branch_city AS STRING), ''),
            '\t',
            IFNULL(CAST(branch_state AS STRING), ''),
            '\t',
            IFNULL(CAST(branch_region AS STRING), ''),
            '\t',
            IFNULL(CAST(customer_id AS STRING), ''),
            '\t',
            IFNULL(CAST(product_id AS STRING), ''),
            '\t',
            IFNULL(CAST(quantity AS STRING), ''),
            '\t',
            IFNULL(CAST(unit_price AS STRING), ''),
            '\t',
            IFNULL(CAST(discount_pct AS STRING), ''),
            '\t',
            IFNULL(CAST(gross_revenue AS STRING), ''),
            '\t',
            IFNULL(CAST(discount_amount AS STRING), ''),
            '\t',
            IFNULL(CAST(net_revenue AS STRING), ''),
            '\t',
            IFNULL(CAST(tax_amount AS STRING), ''),
            '\t',
            IFNULL(CAST(total_price AS STRING), ''),
            '\t',
            IFNULL(CAST(cost_amount AS STRING), ''),
            '\t',
            IFNULL(CAST(profit_amount AS STRING), ''),
            '\t',
            IFNULL(CAST(reward_points AS STRING), ''),
            '\t',
            IFNULL(CAST(payment_method AS STRING), ''),
            '\t',
            IFNULL(CAST(sales_channel AS STRING), ''),
            '\t',
            IFNULL(CAST(promotion_type AS STRING), '')
          ),
          '\n'
        
        ORDER BY
          sale_id
      )
    )
  ) AS row_sha256
FROM `your-project-id.business_insights.fact_sales`
LIMIT 100

SELECT
  COUNTIF(c.customer_id IS NULL) AS orphan_customers,
  COUNTIF(p.product_id IS NULL) AS orphan_products
FROM `your-project-id.business_insights.fact_sales` AS f
LEFT JOIN `your-project-id.business_insights.dim_customers` AS c
  USING (customer_id)
LEFT JOIN `your-project-id.business_insights.dim_products` AS p
  USING (product_id)
LIMIT 100
